name: os-deck
description: OS-Deck: a live agent dock for Claude Code (fork of Flightdeck). Plan by phase with nested subagents, an architect on call, permissions, git and GitHub, the Jira epic, a timeline and the session log, in the active skin's colours, with the Clawd mascot and Agent Proof, which checks what agents claim is done

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the agent types and server tools that count as the on-call architect, e.g. advisor|architect|reviewer

architectLabel.title: Architect label
architectLabel.description: Name shown for the architect role

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission panel

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: main, plan, architect, gate, agents, loops, receipt, log, git, epic, timeline. Leave one out to hide it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

moments.title: Architect moments
moments.description: Show the inferred moment of each consult (before a plan, error repeats, before done)

matchDescriptions.title: Match agent descriptions
matchDescriptions.description: Also count an agent type as the architect when its description (not just its name) matches the pattern

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

view.title: View
view.description: plan: a compact header on top, the plan with each task's subagents nested under it in the middle, the session log filling the foot; classic: the original stacked panels

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: a summary of at most 8 rows when the pane sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: skin wears the skins mod's skin when it is on (theme colours otherwise); theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

style.title: Style
style.description: native draws like the transcript: no coloured frames, one accent colour; cards is the original framed look

background.title: Background
background.description: Hex colour (#rrggbb) to fill the pane with, to match your terminal's background; empty keeps the surface's own

planHint.title: Plan groups
planHint.description: Ask Claude to file each task it creates under a group path (version / epic / story, or whatever fits), so the plan panel can draw the tree

planPolicy.title: Plan policy
planPolicy.description: always: ask Claude to break any multi-step work into tasks filed by phase, so the plan panel always has a plan; hint: only ask it to group the tasks it makes on its own

planPhases.title: Plan phases
planPhases.description: Comma-separated phases tasks are filed under when the policy is always, in order

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Jira site (your-team.atlassian.net): links to the anchored issue, and where the active read looks

jiraFetch.title: Read cited Jira issues
jiraFetch.description: When you cite an issue key Claude does not read itself, read it from Jira through the Atlassian connector (asks permission like any tool call). Off: the plan anchors only to issues Claude reads

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

cswap.title: Account (cswap)
cswap.description: Shows the active cswap (claude-swap) account in the header and lets you switch it with /os-deck account. Without cswap installed the row does not show

cswapCommand.title: cswap command
cswapCommand.description: The cswap executable: a name on the PATH or a full path, when Claude Code cannot find it on the PATH

pet.title: Mascot
pet.description: Draws Clawd, a pixel-art mascot, at the start of the plan view's header; it shows what Claude is doing. Left out in a short dock and in the mini layout

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show context, agents, consults and denials in the status line

gitChildRepos.title: Let git look inside nested repositories
gitChildRepos.description: Off, the Git section does not count untracked files, and a folder holding several repositories shows only each one's branch: both counts make git open nested repositories, whose config or .git file can point it at a network share. Turn on only for folders you trust throughout

github.title: GitHub
github.description: GitHub section in the plan view: the branch's pull request (checks, review, issues it closes) through the gh CLI; with no PR, the repository's open PRs

ghCommand.title: gh command
ghCommand.description: The gh CLI executable, when Claude Code cannot find it on the PATH

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: A native notification when a permission ask waits on you and when a long turn ends

alertAfterS.title: Permission alert (s)
alertAfterS.description: Seconds a permission ask waits before the alert

alertTurnMin.title: Long turn alert (min)
alertTurnMin.description: Minutes a turn must last for its end to be announced
